rci1_using_msad.detail: Multi-site NIH HC (6 pediatric centers) plus single-site HSR HC were aggregated for the normative HC cohort.
rci1_using_msad.supporting_text: "Scans of the NIH HC were obtained at 6 pediatric centers on GE (Cleveland, OH) and Siemens (Munich, Germany) 1.5T scanners."

rci2_using_epd.detail: Reference cohort built from HSR HC and NIH-funded MRI Study of Normal Brain Development; neither is in the predefined EPD list.
rci2_using_epd.supporting_text: "2 groups of pediatric HC were selected... (1) a group of 26 sexand age-matched HC recruited at Hospital San Raffaele (HSR)... and (2) a group of 317 pediatric HC from the NIH-funded MRI Study of Normal Brain Development (NIH HC)"

rci3_epd_name.supporting_text: "2 groups of pediatric HC were selected... (1) a group of 26 sexand age-matched HC recruited at Hospital San Raffaele (HSR)... and (2) a group of 317 pediatric HC from the NIH-funded MRI Study of Normal Brain Development (NIH HC)"

rci5_n.detail: Training phase HC cohort total derived by summing HSR HC (26) and NIH HC (317).

rci6_sex.detail: Training phase; totals computed by summing HSR HC (15/11) and NIH HC (166/151) female/male counts; percentages computed from total N=343.

rci7_age.detail: Training phase; weighted mean and pooled SD computed from HSR HC (mean 15.4, SD 3.8, N=26) and NIH HC (mean 10.8, SD 3.7, N=317). Age range reported for NIH HC; age in years.
rci7_age.supporting_text: "Mean age, y (SD)                     | 15.4 (3.8) | 10.8 (3.7)"; "aged from 4.2 years at the first MRI scan up to 22.3 years at the last MRI scan."
